templates.name: Cross-channel Digest Builder
templates.description: On a daily schedule, fetch recent unread Gmail messages and recent Slack channel activity, merge both branches, and post a single summary to Slack. Connect Google and Slack credentials, set your Slack channel ID, and customize search filters.

templates.name: Daily RSS Digest
templates.description: Fetches a public RSS feed on a schedule, summarizes the latest items with AI, and emails the digest.

templates.name: Daily Weather Briefing
templates.description: Fetches today’s weather for London on a schedule and sends a customized email message.

templates.name: Dropbox AI Document Processor
templates.description: Automatically process new files in Dropbox using the AI Agent to extract structured details and append them to Google Sheets.

templates.name: Dropbox Temp File Cleanup Bot
templates.description: Automatically scan a Dropbox folder, retrieve detailed file metadata (size, last modified time, name), use AI to decide if the file is temporary/expired, and automatically delete it.

templates.name: Dropbox Slack Alerter
templates.description: Send alerts and direct download links to Slack channels automatically when new design mockups or files are added to Dropbox.

templates.name: Dropbox to Slack Campaign Review
templates.description: Daily scheduled workflow to list a folder, filter for newly added image assets using AI, generate temporary download links, and post them to a Slack channel for review.

templates.name: Fortune Cookie
templates.description: The rune onboarding example: what does your fortune cookie say? Run this workflow and find out!

templates.name: GitHub Status
templates.description: GitHub down? Don't check. Automate this workflow and let server downtime be your signal to take a break.

templates.name: Help Wanted Issue Finder
templates.description: Fetches open help wanted issues from rune-org/rune and logs available issues to work on.

templates.name: Maintenance Window Check
templates.description: Checks the current time and logs whether the workflow is running inside a maintenance window.

templates.name: Scheduled API Poll to Sheets Snapshot
templates.description: Poll an HTTP API on a schedule and write the latest response into a Google Sheet range. Connect Google OAuth, replace the API URL and spreadsheet ID, and tune the schedule and column mapping for your data source.

templates.name: sheets → gmail tracker
templates.description: A google sheets / gmail integrated attendance tracker with AI reasoning.

templates.name: Uptime Threshold Check
templates.description: Fetches a public uptime metric and logs whether it meets the target availability threshold.

templates.name: Webhook to Google Sheets Logger
templates.description: Capture incoming webhook payloads and append each submission as a new row in Google Sheets. After using the template, connect a Google OAuth credential, set your spreadsheet ID, and adjust column mappings to match your webhook body.
